humanBrief.hallOfFameSentence: Hall of Fame: same band as {{names}}.

hallOfFame.legalShield: Career-peak figures from published records. Missing axes are estimates from population norms. Not a clinical test and not a federation result. For ladder comparison and entertainment only.
hallOfFame.blockedReply: This Hall of Fame band is above your current score. Raise that axis, and the names in the band open on your readout.
hallOfFame.guidedReply: Which axis? Try: "Who else is at 120 explosive power?" or "Who is at 130 cardio?"

0.overall: Below structured training norms for your age. Technique and a basic plan move this score fast.
0.neuro: Force expression is untrained. Neural recruitment and clean lifts raise this score before mass does.
0.volume: This score mirrors current habits, not potential. Small training and food changes clear 40.

40.overall: Early structured training. Technique and food pairing decide the next step to 50.
40.neuro: Most lifters begin here. Practice and a solid movement base raise output without stacking injuries.
40.volume: Tissue change lags training. Build eating habits and protect training time; 50 is in range with consistency.

50.overall: Population average. Enough for daily life. Clean methods map effort to return toward 60.
50.neuro: Typical gym-goer band. Load control and skill sit above true beginners.
50.volume: Visible change is still thin. Foundation work sits under the score; hold through 60.

60.overall: Among people who actually lift. Irregular trainees rarely hold this without strong genetics. 70 needs time.
60.neuro: Clear gap from beginners. Regular training and diet show in force output. Seventy is earned, not gifted.
60.volume: Muscle or waist change is measurable. Skill is compounding into tissue toward 70.

70.overall: Consistent training, diet control, and injury avoidance put you here. Further gains cost more time and sharper skill.
70.neuro: Outstanding gym cohort. Most need careful training for 70+. Rush invites injury; refined skill keeps the band.
70.volume: Training marks show. Not cover-ready, but direction is set — 80 is on the clock with stacked work.

80.overall: Hard-earned for average genetics; gifted genetics still do not coast past 80. Many athletes treat the 80s as the finish line.
80.neuro: Crowd elite. Advanced in the gym and strong among specialty athletes. Selfies do not buy this band.
80.volume: 80+ physique is a clear training mark. Without outlier genetics, persistence got you here. Peak Natural sits above.

90.overall: For most lifters this is the top of what training alone produces. Further gains are small and slow. If this score came easily, the limiter is no longer effort.
90.neuro: Ordinary genetics at this band means extreme effort at the talent limit. Specialty sport output is elite; higher climbs need matching talent, not grind alone.
90.volume: Strict discipline built this. Rare genetics gate the next step. In any crowd, this is already an elite physique.

100.overall: Gifted genetics plus relentless training. Specialty sports usually see outstanding results at this capacity.
100.neuro: Only extraordinary genetics enter this band. Force output tops most lifters; specialty athletes can dominate here.
100.volume: Physique quality, loaded muscle, or cardio past 100 means discipline plus high-tier talent. Ordinary status is behind.

110.neuro: Rare neural recruitment. Output matches top specialty and elite strength athletes — combat, baseball, basketball champions sit here.
110.volume: Maximally functional physique. VO2 and conditioning rival pro football, combat, and basketball tiers; presence is unmistakable.

120.overall: Standouts of human athletic history. Few peers at this combined intensity.
120.neuro: Force output tears the statistical curve — elite strength-athlete territory. Top talent, extreme effort, huge sacrifice.
120.volume: Look and function cannot be ignored. Muscle, conditioning, or aerobic ceiling already carry historic weight.

130.overall: Global top-tier combined score. Extremely rare and hard to replicate.
130.neuro: Neural recruitment and strength match elite strongmen, powerlifters, and Olympic weightlifting medalists. Rivals are scarce; often only your own PRs remain.
130.volume: Near-ascetic discipline plus rare genetics. Extreme muscle, body-fat, or VO2 numbers make you a hard-to-copy benchmark.

140.overall: No verified player in the database yet — extreme muscle mass and extreme oxygen uptake usually conflict. Archive any confirmed reading.
140.neuro: 140+ neural efficiency and instant power look unreal to normal eyes. Ordinary loads are props; presence dominates any gym or arena.
140.volume: Physique left perfect aesthetics behind. Extreme sacrifice fused with outlier genetics — shredded lines, massive muscle, or VO2 past normal human limits.

150.overall: No verified player in the database yet — extreme muscle mass and extreme oxygen uptake usually conflict. Archive any confirmed reading.
150.neuro: Pinnacle absolute force. Stands with the highest legends in sports history. Unmatched output on the planet.
150.volume: Rivals world-record physiques. Biology as close as it gets to a finished masterpiece. History keeps the peak.
